qeHelp_status: Published quizzes accept attempts; drafts and archived quizzes do not.
qeHelp_passing_score_percentage: Minimum percentage of points needed to pass.
qeHelp_min_answered_percentage: Minimum percentage of questions that must be answered before submitting.
qeHelp_min_correct_percentage: Minimum percentage of fully correct questions required to submit, independent of the passing score.
qeHelp_scoring_mode: Exact: full points only for a completely correct answer. Partial: proportional points for multiple choice and matching, with a penalty for wrong choices.
qeHelp_correctness_visibility: When to show whether an answer is correct. After finishing requires attempt review to be allowed.
qeHelp_correct_answers_visibility: When to reveal the correct options or matches, independently of answer correctness. After finishing requires review.
qeHelp_explanation_visibility: When to show the saved explanation. After finishing requires review; the incorrect-only setting also applies.
qeHelp_explanation_incorrect_only: Show explanations only for incorrect answers. Turn off to explain every answer, when explanation visibility allows.
qeHelp_allow_answer_changes_after_check: Allow repeated changes after saving/checking. When off, the first complete saved answer is locked.
qeHelp_allow_attempt_review: Allow reviewing answers after the attempt ends, according to the feedback visibility settings.
qeHelp_show_final_score: Show the final score and pass/fail result after finishing.
qeHelp_has_certificate: Award a certificate when the quiz is passed.
qeUnlinkQuestions: Remove the selected questions from this quiz? Original questions stay in the bank.
qeResultPassed: You’ve reached the passing score. Well done!
qeResultFailed: You haven’t reached the passing score yet. Keep learning and give it another go when an attempt is available.
qeHelp_max_points: Maximum points for a completely correct answer.
qeImportCreatesNew: Each import creates new questions, including when the same file is imported again.
qeExportOwnBank: Export includes only your own questions.
qeHelp_questions_per_page: Number of questions shown together on each page of an attempt. Defaults to 1. Changes apply to new attempts.

privacyPolicy.intro.p2: This notice explains how , trading as , processes personal data when you use (the “Platform”). It also explains your choices and data-protection rights. This notice applies to the Platform website, account, video, playlist, quiz, comment, support, and related learning features.

privacyPolicy.data-purpose-basis.p1: Profile biography, profile photo, and membership status are optional. Please do not include patient, medical, or other special-category personal data in profiles, comments, uploads, or AI prompts.

privacyPolicy.sources.li2: automatically from your browser/device and your use of the Platform;
privacyPolicy.sources.li3: from Google if you choose “Continue with Google” (basic identity data needed to sign you in); and
privacyPolicy.sources.li4: from an organization that sponsors or administers your access, where applicable.
privacyPolicy.required-data.p1: Name, email, password or third-party sign-in credentials, and acceptance of the Terms are required to create a standard account. If you do not provide them, we cannot create or authenticate the account. Optional profile fields and personalization are not required to use the core Platform. The AI assistant is available as an optional user-invoked feature.
privacyPolicy.sharing.p1: We disclose personal data only where needed to operate the Platform or meet legal obligations:
privacyPolicy.sharing.li1: , for video hosting, delivery, playback, and related technical video services;
privacyPolicy.sharing.li2: Google, only when you choose Google sign-in;
privacyPolicy.sharing.li3: the AI assistant provider at , which delivers the assistant interface and processes chat messages after you confirm inside the chat;
privacyPolicy.sharing.li4: hosting, infrastructure, email, security, and support providers acting under contractual instructions;
privacyPolicy.sharing.li5: your sponsoring organization or content partner, where applicable, for access administration and reporting; user-level details are limited to what is necessary, and reporting should be aggregated where possible; and
privacyPolicy.sharing.li6: courts, regulators, law enforcement, or other parties where law requires it or legal claims make it necessary.
privacyPolicy.sharing.p2: We do not sell personal data or use it for third-party behavioral advertising.
privacyPolicy.cookies.h21: 6) Cookies, local storage, and optional services
privacyPolicy.cookies.p1: The Platform uses browser storage for authentication/session state, language, autoplay, navigation continuity, and your privacy choices. These items are necessary to provide settings or functions you request. The privacy choice record contains the preference version, selected categories, and the time the choice was saved.
privacyPolicy.cookies.p2: Personalized recommendations remain disabled until you choose them. The AI assistant launcher is available by default and its provider can receive technical connection data, such as your IP address and browser/device information, to deliver the widget. Before using the chat, the widget asks you to confirm its privacy notice. Anything you submit is sent to the assistant provider. Do not submit patient or other sensitive personal data.
privacyPolicy.automated.p1: If you enable personalization, automated methods use viewing and interaction history to rank or suggest content. This does not produce legal or similarly significant effects. You can turn personalization off at any time in Privacy choices; the Platform will then stop requesting and displaying personalized recommendations.
privacyPolicy.retention.p1: We apply the following retention criteria:
privacyPolicy.retention.li1: Account and profile data: while the account is active, then only as needed for legal obligations, security, fraud prevention, or legal claims.
privacyPolicy.retention.li2: Learning and interaction data: while needed to provide progress, history, certificates, playlists, comments, and other account features, subject to a valid rights request.
privacyPolicy.retention.li3: Authentication, security, and audit logs: for the shortest period needed to detect and investigate security or abuse and meet documented legal requirements.
privacyPolicy.retention.li4: Support and rights-request records: until the matter is closed, then for the period needed to demonstrate that the request was handled and manage legal claims.
privacyPolicy.retention.li5: Privacy choices: until you replace the choice, clear browser storage, or the preference version changes.
privacyPolicy.retention.p2: Data may remain in restricted backups until the normal backup cycle replaces it. The operator maintains the detailed retention schedule used to turn these criteria into operational deletion periods.
privacyPolicy.transfers.p1: The controller is in the United States, and some providers may process data outside the European Economic Area. Where GDPR transfer restrictions apply, transfers must rely on an adequacy decision or appropriate safeguards, such as the European Commission’s Standard Contractual Clauses, together with supplementary measures where required. Contact <link0><value1/></link0> to ask about the safeguard relevant to your data or request a copy.
privacyPolicy.rights.p1: Where GDPR applies, and subject to its conditions and exceptions, you can:
privacyPolicy.rights.li1: ask whether we process your data and receive access and a copy;
privacyPolicy.rights.li3: request erasure or restriction of processing;
privacyPolicy.rights.li4: receive data you provided in a structured, commonly used, machine-readable format and request transfer where technically feasible;
privacyPolicy.rights.li5: object to processing based on legitimate interests;
privacyPolicy.rights.li6: withdraw consent at any time, without affecting earlier lawful processing; and
privacyPolicy.rights.li7: lodge a complaint with the data protection authority where you live or work, or where the alleged infringement occurred.
privacyPolicy.rights.p2: Edit profile data from your account page, manage optional processing through Privacy choices, or send any rights request to <link0><value1/></link0>. We normally respond without undue delay and within one month. You can find EU supervisory authorities through the <link2>European Data Protection Board member list</link2>.
privacyPolicy.security.p1: We use technical and organizational safeguards appropriate to risk, including access controls, encryption in transit, authentication, service monitoring, backups, and incident handling. No internet service can guarantee absolute security. Please use a unique password and notify us if you believe your account is compromised.
privacyPolicy.children.p1: The Platform is intended for professional education and is not directed to children. Account holders must be at least 18 years old or the age of majority in their country, whichever is higher. Contact us if you believe a child provided personal data contrary to this requirement.
privacyPolicy.changes.p1: We may update this notice to reflect service, legal, or processing changes. We will post the new effective date here and provide a prominent in-product or email notice when a change materially affects how personal data is used.
